## [1.16.0-dev.1](https://github.com/jordanwoodson/lurk-morphe-patches/compare/v1.15.1...v1.16.0-dev.1) (2026-11-04)

### Kick

#### 🚀 Updated App Support

* support Kick 40.34.0

### Twitch

#### ✨ New Features

* add 7TV badges
* add a **Sleep timer** row to the player's settings sheet
* add a {channel} placeholder to **Playlist proxy**

#### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* open Following at launch in the React Native Home
* stop dual-format streams from crashing the app
